title: explore-worker factual quality independent of skill loading
prompt:
阅读这个陌生项目，核对入口、默认端口、调用关系和存储方式。返回 entry（相对路径）、default_port（整数）、call_edges（main->build_worker 这种字符串数组）、storage（memory 或 disk）、storage_source（相对路径）、launches_http_server（布尔值）。
最终只返回一个 JSON 对象（不要改文件），使用题面规定的字段；数组顺序不限。
call_edges 只列出从 main 经项目内工厂函数到存储对象构造的两条直接调用边，不列传递调用或内置函数；类构造可以写类名或类名.__init__，不得省略第二条构造边。
调用边的模块限定名、空括号和箭头两侧空格可以省略或保留；不要把传递依赖写成直接调用，也不要写参数列表。

graders.expects: Structured facts match the independent fixture oracle; keywords alone do not pass.
graders.evidence: Final JSON fields against source files; exact factual contract, not general prose quality.

notes: Expected relevant workflow: project-explorer. Skill loading is an observation, never a prerequisite for quality pass. Structured output is explicitly requested; no claim about unrestricted prose quality. v2 explicitly scopes both required direct call edges and accepts equivalent Class/Class.__init__ notation. v1 false negatives are retained under the original protocol. v3 additionally accepts harmless qualified names, whitespace and empty-call parentheses. This fixes a v2 false negative for create_app->Ledger(); incorrect caller/callee and missing edges still fail.
